introHtml: Choosing a 14 oz lanyard means you get a mid-weight option that balances durability with comfort. Heavier than budget lanyards but lighter than heavy-duty straps, the 14 oz weight works well for daily badge wear without feeling bulky. Ideal for trade shows or corporate ID badges, these lanyards hold up to frequent use and can be decorated with silkscreening or full-color imprint. The 1/2" Cotton Eyewear Retainer is a popular example in this weight class, offering a soft feel against the neck.
heroAltText: Custom 14 oz lanyards with full-color imprint and metal clip, ideal for corporate ID badges and events
